# MovingAverage CLIP Node — Integration Guide
## Generated by CLIP_GEN v4.5

## Algorithm Description

This CLIP node implements a 16-sample sliding-window moving average filter.
Each enabled clock cycle the oldest sample is dropped, the newest is added to
a running accumulator, and the result is multiplied by the pre-scaled gain
`AvgGain = 1/16` — eliminating any runtime division on the FPGA.

| Default | Value |
|---|---|
| Build mode | Quick Build (files 1–5 + clip_preflight.py) |
| Target FPGA | xc7k70tfbg676-1 (NI cRIO-class Kintex-7) |
| Master clock | 40 MHz |
| VHDL standard | VHDL-2008 |
| Window size N | 16 samples |
| Input / Output FXP | FXP<+/-,32,16> signed, IWL=16, FWL=16, LSB≈1.526e-5 |
| AvgGain FXP | FXP<+/-,32,8> signed, IWL=8, FWL=24, LSB≈5.96e-8 |
| Reset | `aReset`, active-high, synchronous inside `rising_edge` |
| Enable | `Ce`, active-high |
| Closed-loop test | None |

## Terminal Mapping Table

| Front Panel Label | VHDL Port | Direction | FXP Format | Range | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clk | Clk | ToCLIP | std_logic (clock) | 40 MHz | Wire to SCTL clock reference |
| aReset | aReset | ToCLIP | Boolean | 0/1 | High clears all state synchronously |
| Ce | Ce | ToCLIP | Boolean | 0/1 | Low freezes filter; high enables update |
| Data In (0-100%) | DataIn | ToCLIP | FXP<+/-,32,16> | 0.0–100.0 | Raw process signal in percent |
| Avg Gain (1/N) | AvgGain | ToCLIP | FXP<+/-,32,8> | 0.0625 for N=16 | Computed on RT; write once at startup |
| Data Out (0-100%) | DataOut | FromCLIP | FXP<+/-,32,16> | 0.0–100.0 | Averaged output |
| Overflow | Overflow | FromCLIP | Boolean | 0/1 | High if accumulator guard bits exceeded |

## LabVIEW FPGA Import Procedure

1. In the LabVIEW FPGA project, right-click the FPGA target →
   **Properties → Component-Level IP**.
2. Click **Add** and browse to `MovingAverage.xml`.
   Confirm the Declaration Name shows `MovingAverage` with no red X.
   *(If a red X appears: verify `MovingAverage.vhd` is in the **same
   directory** as the `.xml` file.)*
3. Click OK. The **IP Integration Node** appears in the block diagram
   palette under Component-Level IP.
4. Place the node inside a **Single-Cycle Timed Loop (SCTL)**.
5. **Wire terminals:**
   - `Clk` → SCTL clock reference terminal
   - `Ce` → SCTL Loop Tick output (or wire `TRUE` constant for always-on)
   - `aReset` → system reset Boolean
   - `Data In (0-100%)` → FXP control or upstream data source
   - `Avg Gain (1/N)` → write from RT host at startup
   - `Data Out (0-100%)` → FXP indicator or downstream node
   - `Overflow` → Boolean indicator (monitor during initial test)
6. **IP Terminals page** *(critical — skipping this makes all FXP
   constants 32,32)*:
   Right-click the node → **IP Terminals** and set:
   - `Data In (0-100%)` and `Data Out (0-100%)`:
     Signed=true, WordLength=32, IntegerWordLength=**16**
   - `Avg Gain (1/N)`:
     Signed=true, WordLength=32, IntegerWordLength=**8**
7. Compile. Expected resources on xc7k70tfbg676-1: ~20 FFs, ~1 DSP48 slice.

## Pipeline Latency

| Stage | Cycles |
|---|---|
| Input latch + shift register update | 1 |
| Accumulator update | 1 |
| Gain multiply + arithmetic shift | 1 |
| Output register | 1 |
| **Total end-to-end** | **4 clock cycles at 40 MHz = 100 ns** |

`DataOut` reflects the 16-sample average ending 4 cycles after `DataIn`
is presented with `Ce` high.

## Ce Rate vs. Master Clock

The CLIP runs at 40 MHz. `Ce` should be driven by the SCTL loop tick at
your desired sample rate (e.g., 1 kHz, 10 kHz). When `Ce` is low the
accumulator and shift register are frozen; `DataOut` holds its last value.

## What NOT to Do

- **Do not compute `1/N` inside the SCTL.** Always pre-compute `AvgGain`
  on the RT side and write it once at startup.
- **Do not leave `Avg Gain (1/N)` undriven.** An undriven FXP terminal
  defaults to zero, producing zero output regardless of input.
- **Do not set IP Terminals after placing constants.** Set the FXP format
  first, then wire controls to the terminals.
- **Do not use N > 128.** AvgGain FXP<+/-,32,8> minimum positive value
  is ≈ 0.0078, which corresponds to N=128.

## Pre-Compile Checklist

- [ ] `MovingAverage.vhd` and `MovingAverage.xml` are in the same directory
- [ ] CLIP Declaration Name shows `MovingAverage` with no red X
- [ ] IP Terminals set: DataIn/DataOut IWL=16, AvgGain IWL=8
- [ ] `Clk` wired to SCTL clock reference
- [ ] `Ce` wired to SCTL loop tick or TRUE constant
- [ ] `aReset` wired to system reset Boolean
- [ ] `Avg Gain (1/N)` written from RT at startup (value ≈ 0.0625 for N=16; bit pattern 0x00100000)
- [ ] `Overflow` indicator monitored during initial test
- [ ] No broken wires on FPGA block diagram
- [ ] `ghdl -a --std=08 MovingAverage.vhd` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `python clip_preflight.py MovingAverage.vhd MovingAverage.xml` shows 30/30 ✅
